title: REQ · Over-limit text shows an inline message and blocks submit
summary: When trimmed text exceeds MAX_PROMPT_LENGTH an inline message shows and Send does nothing
description: Context: handleSubmit only blocks blank text. Desired behavior: compute over-limit from trimmed character count; show an inline message, set aria-invalid, and refuse to submit. Expected result: over-limit ideas are never sent. Why: backend would reject them anyway.
acceptance_criteria: Given 501 characters, Then the message 'Too long: 501 / 500' is visible in a role=alert element
Given 501 characters, When Send is clicked, Then submitContribution is not called and the text is kept
Given 500 characters, Then no over-limit message shows and Send submits
Given over-limit text is edited down to 500 characters, Then the message disappears

preserve: Textarea is not hard-truncated so the message is reachable

technical_constraints: Do not set the maxLength attribute, because it would make the over-limit state unreachable
definition_of_done: Over-limit blocks submit and shows message
